subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the grammatically correct sentence.**

A. Vegetables are an important source of energy. A balanced diet must include vegetables.

B. Vegetables are a important source of energy. A balanced diet must include vegetables.

C. Vegetables are an important source of energy. Balanced diet must include vegetables.

D. Vegetables are a important source of energy. Balanced diet must include vegetables.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Vegetables are an important source of energy. A balanced diet must include vegetables."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence in **option 4** has proper subject-verb agreement ("are" agrees with "vegetables").
 
• Option 4 uses the correct article **"an"** before **"important"** because **"important"** starts with a vowel sound.
 
• Option 4 uses proper capitalization for** "Balanced diet"** as it is a proper noun and "a" is used before the phrase "balanced diet." 
 
• So, the correct answer is Option 4.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: **"A"** must be used before the phrase "balanced diet."
 
• Option 2: **"A"** should be "an" before **"important."**
 
• Option 3: "A" should be "an" before "important" and "a" must be used before the phrase "balanced diet."
